item.title: fix(ui): quiet tool-activity rows with one hover treatment (#120674)
item.summary: fix(ui): quiet tool-activity rows with one hover treatment (#120674) Replace the bordered activity-group card (border + background + hairline row separators + per-row radius flattening) with a flat indented list and a single 2px left rail. Every tool row now shares the same 6px hover pill inside and outside groups, removing the square/round corner mismatch. Also scope the generic .chat-bubble:hover accent-border rule away from tool-shell bubbles: it tinted the group's hairline separators red on hover, which read as an error state.
